item.title: Island Beach State Park — Sat Nov 21, 8:45 AM — NJ
item.description:
One of the gems of the state park system, Island Beach has miles of beach, tidal wetlands, maritime forest and thickets that can host a good diversity of birds, especially if the winds are right. November sees peak numbers of migratory waterfowl, loons, gannets, and other seabirds and is a good time of year for rarities. There is a $5 entry fee for NJ residents who do not have a state park pass or are 65 years of age or older. Be prepared for several hours of walking on flat terrain, sometimes sandy. Bring lunch. Led by Scott Barnes and Linda Mack. A NOTE ON MEETING LOCATION! We’ll meet just outside of the park entrance, in the median parking lot at the end of Rt. 35. PRE-REGISTRATION REQUIRED COST: $25 Members, $30 Non-members REGISTER HERE
Source: NJ Audubon

item.title: Chester County Horse-Shoe and More Hike — Sun Nov 29, 8:30 AM
item.description: Metrotrails: NJ, PA, NY Metropolitan Area Hiking and More! Join us for this point to point hike in rural Chester County Pennsylvania, featuring some prominent trails including the Horse-Shoe Trail, as well as other connections! I have planned this one specifically because it is a Sunday that hunting isn't permitted in some of the preserves along the way, and because most of the route is pleasant but within safety zones. After meeting at Bryn Coed, we will shuttle with as few vehicles as possible to our start point, at Highland Farm Park. We'll start by walking some of the trails to the north, through fields and a wood line, out into a development. We'll cut through the development and then out to the Pickering Creek Trail. We'll take the Station Blvd Trail north to the Eagle Farms Trail east, then turn onto the pleasant Chester Springs Road. item.title: Holiday New York City Hike! — Sat Dec 19, 9:00 AM
item.description: Metrotrails: NJ, PA, NY Metropolitan Area Hiking and More! Join us for our annual Holiday New York City Hike! This year, we'll meet at New York Penn Station, in the mall type area with the large Christmas tree like we usually do (it's in the cover photo here). This would be the big circular area in NY Penn Station. From there, we'll all take the subway north to Van Cortland Park, Bronx, and we'll start with a bunch of the trails there we've never done before. From there, we head west toward the Hudson River where we'll begin heading south on some of the trails and walkways. We'll walk the newly reopened pedestrian lanes over Henry Hudson Bridge and then follow slopes though Inwood Hills Park and Fort Tryon Park. After this, we'll try to take the Hudson River Greenway and Empire State Trail, but keep to the more middle section of it. item.description:
This is a paid Adult School class. Click here to register.
A workshop for anyone who wants to write or wants to infuse their existing writing practice with new energy. In each class, we'll consider one element of fiction or creative non-fiction, such as point of view, narrative voice, and what makes a piece of writing riveting, or boring. Students can expect in-class writing prompts, reading aloud, and optional homework. Positive encouragement, rather than formal critiques, will be featured, and inspiration and organization for writers will be discussed. Students should bring whatever they use to write to each class.
